blocks.text: The Indonesian police world was shaken by a shocking news this morning. The Lito Police General Sigit Prabwo is officially dismissed from the office of the Chief. President Prabowo Subianto sent the President's Surpress Number R57 / Pres / 09 / 2026 on September 30, 2026 to the House of Ri with a proposal for his dismissal and his replacement.

The iII Commission went straight to fit and proxy test on proposed single candidates, Pol's Commissioner. Suyudi Ario Seto. The results are aclamation approved. Not long after, the Paripurna House meeting also approved an honorable discharge with Lito Sigit Prabowo and the Suyudi Appointment as the new Chief of Police.
The chairman of the House of Maharani declared the reason for the dismissal: "Respectfully, it is time."
This shift is going very fast and without the drama to open. Suyudi is scheduled to be sworn in sometime soon.

The public is wondering why Lithyo is being replaced now. Is it just because the term of office is over, or is there a political dynamic behind the scenes? Until recently, there has been no official explanation of the Palace.
One thing's for sure: the era of Lito Sigit Prabwo as the official Chief of Police ends today.
